column2: a lord's great hall: long and tall, a stone ground course and timber-framed cream plaster walls above, a tall steep roof of red clay tiles, a big arched oak double door in the long side with stone steps, tall arched windows, a small timber bell turret with a red tile cap on the ridge, chimneys of warm grey stone

a medieval European stone parish church of warm grey stone: a nave under a steep red clay tile roof, a square stone bell tower at one end with a short red tile spire and a plain simple cross finial, arched windows, an arched wooden door, buttresses; no franchise symbols

a two-storey timber-framed guild hall: an open arcaded ground floor of stone arches, a jettied cream plaster and dark oak upper storey with leaded windows, a steep red clay tile roof with a dormer, a hanging wooden sign with no text
